tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Induced Orientation on a Boundary] 1. chB:B.17If $M$ is an oriented smooth manifold with boundary, then $\partial M$ is orientable, and it has a canonical orientation (called the induced orientation or Stokes orientation) determined by $\iota ^*(N \lrcorner \mu )$, where $\iota : \partial M \hookrightarrow M$ is inclusion, $N$ is any outward-pointing vector field along $\partial M$, and $\mu $ is any positively oriented orientation form for $M$.
